notifications.title: An army from Zaslavl starved
notifications.body: With no food left it scattered; none of them will come back.

notifications.title: The Holy City held
notifications.body: The horde was beaten at its walls after 4 rounds.

notifications.title: The Iron Span: Beat the Smith-Breakers
notifications.body: Nav knows the forge is lit. The Smith-Breakers, a host sworn to put out Svarog's flame, march on the Holy City apart from the hordes: beat them before the walls, and the iron can be forged.
